content.what_it_is: MATLAB script for the FUNWAVE-TVD wave_coherence case plotting the mean current field of the Case_DATA2D_2Waves run over bathymetry. Inputs (L4-L7): case directory, coordinates x=2:2:500, y=2:2:1000 (2 m spacing), mean-output number file_no=1. It loads umean_00001 and vmean_00001, mask_00000, and dep.out (L10-L14), NaNs dry cells (L15-L16), plots pcolor(x,y,-depth) with caxis [-8 2], xlim [150 500], ylim [0 1000], aspect 350:1000 (L18-L24), overlays a white quiver of the mean current subsampled every skx=sky=5 points scaled by cc=75 with AutoScale off (L26-L32), plus a reference arrow of length cc/4 labeled '25 cm/s' at (170,60) (L33-L34). It then marks dry cells with copper-colored dots: flattens xx,yy and u, selects points where u is NaN, and plots them as sand (L36-L45). Saves figures/current.jpg (L47-L48) and closes (L49).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
file_no — mean-output number, reformatted to 5-digit string (L7, L10)
XX_Dry, YY_Dry — coordinates of dry (NaN) cells (L41-L42)

equations.ref: masking dry cells in the mean velocity
reference arrow: length cc/4 = 18.75 corresponds to 0.25 m/s at scale cc=75

io.name: bathymetry pcolor with mean-current quiver, reference arrow, and dry-cell sand dots

unresolved: The quiver at L30-L32 indexes the vectors x,y with 2D subscripts and mixes strides (x uses skx twice, u/v use (1:sky:end,1:skx:end)); it works only because skx==sky==5 — changing one stride breaks the coordinate/data alignment.
Coordinates x=2:2:500, y=2:2:1000 (L5-L6) start at 2 rather than 0; whether this matches the model's cell-center convention for the 250x500 grid is not verifiable from this file.
The mask is taken from time 00000 while the mean fields are output 00001 (L11-L13); a moving shoreline between the two would misclassify cells.
colors(190,:) (L44) assumes the copper colormap has at least 190 rows (default 256); fails under smaller colormap settings.
file_no is overwritten from number to string (L7, L10), a minor type reuse.
